1 An invented preprint about counting widgets
2 Widgets were counted at three simulated sites every week.
3 Two observers took part, and their counts were compared.
4 Agreement was high, and the counts rose slightly over the year.
5 Nothing in this text describes a real study.
6 Each line carries a manuscript line number, as accepted
7 manuscripts and preprints often do.



8 The second page continues the numbering from the first.
9 Its lines are numbered in the same gutter.
10 A table row such as 12 widgets keeps its inner number.
